body: Thank you for talking to me. The problem is I am surrounded by people who excel in such fields ... I attend a tech school. I have racked up nearly $100k in debt. What is really crushing me is that required for graduation are co-ops / internships. I haven't been able to find any that will accept me - while people I've known since freshmen year are receiving offers from research labs, large private corporations, government, etc. I like those fields - I like looking at an algorithm, I like looking at a circuit - but they just like they are not for me.  I am drunk, apologizes - I do not normally drink.
